verdict.rationale: Ghostty publishes libghostty, a first-party C and Zig library for building terminal emulators or using terminal functionality. Only `libghostty-vt` is described as usable today, and it covers C/Zig only. No SDK exists for driving or reading a running Ghostty instance: the runtime probe found no remote-control or IPC interface. Missing for 10: SDK docs or API reference, SDKs in mainstream languages beyond C/Zig, full libghostty availability beyond the VT component, an SDK for controlling the Ghostty app, and independent corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: `libghostty` is a cross-platform, zero-dependency C and Zig library for building terminal emulators or utilizing terminal functionality (such as style parsing).
`libghostty-vt` is already available and usable today for Zig and C and is compatible for macOS, Linux, Windows, and WebAssembly.
Anyone can use `libghostty` to build a terminal emulator or embed a terminal into their own applications.
